Keep every row in order. Preserve all [[I]], [[B]], [[SC]] emphasis markers, [[Nnumber]] note markers and explicit source line counts. Do not return hashes; the host binds immutable hashes.", "context": {"title": "Notre-Dame de Paris", "unit": 51, "heading": "I\nGRINGOIRE A PLUSIEURS BONNES IDÉES DE SUITE RUE DES BERNARDINS", "previous_rows": [{"source_id": "fr86-u051-b0030", "target": "—Это всё то же равновесие, — сказал Гренгуар. — Когда у человека есть мысль, он находит её во всём.", "source_sha256": "9ed95f5dc5f06c5450b7344ca0ba616957e2a35410147a60c6ff9a8febd09fea", "target_id": "ru-fr86-u051-b0030", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "d5951f3313a63ad4aa4ecaa20e9d0c6c991fb01b62b22b026cf6a37ce9ac5d0d"}, {"source_id": "fr86-u051-b0031", "target": "—Я знаю», — ответил архидиакон.", "source_sha256": "d18e6fdfb855decdfa3f2bd985fc5dc33f685c1ee1fb66c946d46f894ff1bd2a", "target_id": "ru-fr86-u051-b0031", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "0009e029fbd8b8d9683c77f69e95014d61b70a9dac76b7dedd812ac8dc31aa24"}], "source_language": "French", "part": null, "book": 10, "chapter": 1, "role": "CHAPTER"}, "source_rows": [{"id": "fr86-u051-b0032", "text": "Après un silence, le prêtre reprit: «Vous êtes néanmoins assez misérable?", "sha256": "600073e271addfb78312bc9ac95119e46fa30f74117accf69f85968f4d66bf0c", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [2977], "source_xml_sha256": "fbb5a730986b40bc6367ad9980f820e15cd65226a50e2b51ae03b63d817ca96f", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u051-b0033", "text": "—Misérable, oui; malheureux, non.»", "sha256": "51194606a7fa4a2c0c1be81f074ec785d80ea4b697a91e4a954040297a902e02", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [2978], "source_xml_sha256": "73c12d2bb3f619884c5089646c16fe56f58e0c131819b2d261f659b2df8e697c", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u051-b0034", "text": "En ce moment, un bruit de chevaux se fit entendre, et nos deux interlocuteurs virent défiler au bout de la rue une compagnie des archers de l'ordonnance du roi, les lances hautes, l'officier en tête. La cavalcade était brillante et résonnait sur le pavé.", "sha256": "e0b486b8bba946eb7290c3a1b906860982c520334168d4847f7fe2e307547dc8", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [2979], "source_xml_sha256": "39bfe3260626d66bf201b1aeb5a54dc6f3f4f60dfa31ce42e707568d3494ae2e", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u051-b0035", "text": "«Comme vous regardez cet officier! dit Gringoire à l'archidiacre.", "sha256": "cf491742110cb1f3a63426b9d016501b556b1c34a7f6235e79eaa634d72b8f41", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [2980], "source_xml_sha256": "9187474e464bbc9f52799981774e2e89906d6c21783bac0dd52372a2174595e8", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u051-b0036", "text": "—C'est que je crois le reconnaître.", "sha256": "7c97f150119066c31e90a93297411edabd3913b185810f82b9192cce7eac657f", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [2981], "source_xml_sha256": "7c4224c7ec5143ea8b8b0f57b76054d629946370690096d5a601daba1b37783a", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u051-b0037", "text": "—Comment le nommez-vous?", "sha256": "e7c4b062b121ff76a03bd6b01e1e707a2c75602851d06069d6a880b4cf0f9cd6", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [2982], "source_xml_sha256": "df75c63ac9a13868291f92636d99e264922a032e01880d25b666ee025e4a3782", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u051-b0038", "text": "—Je crois, dit Claude, qu'il s'appelle Phoebus de Châteaupers.", "sha256": "74cd443b14ff1acdbc79681c0383daa5f4f044148f6921c968b28120d3c9db9b", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [2983], "source_xml_sha256": "fda8cf046e227488e3950b566db81f6f76f3bdf00153048caa072fd39c5dd0a1", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u051-b0039", "text": "—Phoebus! un nom de curiosité! Il y a aussi Phoebus, comte de Foix. J'ai souvenir d'avoir connu une fille qui ne jurait que par Phoebus.", "sha256": "86f5801ff0cfb41b7a6fda63b06fddb22042425e238286fee100c9c1f7245c1e", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [2984], "source_xml_sha256": "763bd3db257bb54aff90ea6b0556df14b4f29d02e76f249030051e050553cb87", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u051-b0040", "text": "—Venez-vous-en, dit le prêtre. J'ai quelque chose à vous dire.»", "sha256": "db5a20ff808a3737177988f381e48d73f5badd72af74432a36ebc8d9eec63fb8", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [2985], "source_xml_sha256": "d336f358102e439b35c66fd08c77f0b56901a54ea2c23c12954227e4ffeb7ac3", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u051-b0041", "text": "Depuis le passage de cette troupe, quelque agitation perçait sous l'enveloppe glaciale de l'archidiacre. Il se mit à marcher. Gringoire le suivait, habitué à lui obéir, comme tout ce qui avait approché une fois cet homme plein d'ascendant. Ils arrivèrent en silence jusqu'à la rue des Bernardins qui était assez déserte. Dom Claude s'y arrêta.", "sha256": "b79f9879cdbb30903defdcbc0613458774783242e5c868330ed3b519b5f16cf1", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [2986], "source_xml_sha256": "17a3d9ba9c2dcf897ada8dabd387095d24bba7932cf937954493fccaf5b3cb88", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u051-b0042", "text": "«Qu'avez-vous à me dire, mon maître? lui demanda Gringoire.", "sha256": "e91e4f93f49c885c1b0a5e80fdb3e6dea2794495a4ef207243edec754eca9fbb", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [2987], "source_xml_sha256": "642baf9e21a2bb7260f3a816a920936301e86d7f509720eb3339ceaacdc26c48", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u051-b0043", "text": "—Est-ce que vous ne trouvez pas, répondit l'archidiacre d'un air de profonde réflexion, que l'habit de ces cavaliers que nous venons de voir est plus beau que le vôtre et que le mien?»", "sha256": "ea852f66326415df50b242bb4ebff267c1a44c3f3cfd91505c65afd46b58e166", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [2988], "source_xml_sha256": "7436e8e679fc41805233d344ee7f251fbdf1142448d79cb18c282e223950e53b", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u051-b0044", "text": "Gringoire hocha la tête.", "sha256": "dae8d3d93a34f1390b2204b3f3ceb209f2ef816055f4df0604ebc7fc967223c6", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [2989], "source_xml_sha256": "6e0f2fa388c197263d82ed7a4e19f382ad27f6080bc5b0293c20659ef71dd6aa", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u051-b0045", "text": "«Ma foi! j'aime mieux ma gonelle jaune et rouge que ces écailles de fer et d'acier. Beau plaisir, de faire en marchant le même bruit que le quai de la Ferraille par un tremblement de terre!", "sha256": "0cc8cd53ff386dc43e30fb6b5f254244b6f864e2149fb17b425d5de5a72649fd", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [2990], "source_xml_sha256": "b93ed4325a4997cca09a55ab6bbfed11ba2681f97196ed87b18be9e26ab250dd", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u051-b0046", "text": "—Donc, Gringoire, vous n'avez jamais porté envie à ces beaux fils en hoquetons de guerre?", "sha256": "a0d7a19c53cb40826447ca99837abfdaebcd7605f31a82711679ef6741b71689", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [2991], "source_xml_sha256": "c85aceb3bfba94bbf44a653e0fe35d952c1e572be41c39c72337cdd09befefa7", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u051-b0047", "text": "—Envie de quoi, monsieur l'archidiacre? de leur force, de leur armure, de leur discipline? Mieux valent la philosophie et l'indépendance en guenilles. J'aime mieux être tête de mouche que queue de lion.", "sha256": "685c33b4cbbaa6689a05dbdbc0b2ac9ac8c73c465262ff7792550f21b0da1ec9", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [2992], "source_xml_sha256": "73e28ad60325411eecf50b185d309bc643f315f3392455de59f82804d7283049", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u051-b0048", "text": "—Cela est singulier, dit le prêtre rêveur. Une belle livrée est pourtant belle.»", "sha256": "17a6c7878d70ff77e8f1a7c6c3c5b60be6a2ab16dae6054b2592345f10749ecb", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [2993], "source_xml_sha256": "da9ba01bb81d39716e076fa8fe85bd5efa9678305d0ca87cfbae15f806edef6e", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u051-b0049", "text": "Gringoire, le voyant pensif, le quitta pour aller admirer le porche d'une maison voisine. Il revint en frappant des mains. «Si vous étiez moins occupé des beaux habits des gens de guerre, monsieur l'archidiacre, je vous prierais d'aller voir cette porte. Je l'ai toujours dit, la maison du sieur Aubry a une entrée la plus superbe du monde.", "sha256": "51f769232d620645ed054c24e264771b3c900cedf8333392f0262dc3470a2bd4", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [2994], "source_xml_sha256": "6aa5c2229d336309a31e4ddbc2967ce793680351b98266eefd9eb328d6623050", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u051-b0050", "text": "—Pierre Gringoire, dit l'archidiacre, qu'avez-vous fait de cette petite danseuse égyptienne?", "sha256": "7856bfc7f41b8f154e692467a81e2e49ea66a6b1ba826341cdebc9e1d881ad0c", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [2995], "source_xml_sha256": "eecc05c7e77a8a92169aa7feeab35160902ecc57b6b2d76327b90a1cd94dff88", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u051-b0051", "text": "—La Esmeralda? Vous changez bien brusquement de conversation.", "sha256": "6afc4fe9bff54a52bf86addb451133060244ca222c92e3fc534557780543ac2f", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [2996], "source_xml_sha256": "7d181d18c44dd8c68d04ee6122634e0be6efef51843ea5d55854fb9261c6280b", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u051-b0052", "text": "—N'était-elle pas votre femme?", "sha256": "a155d84e9bc13ec22e424ebdca238602b7bcaaca35f41a9427d8bdf49d459947", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [2997], "source_xml_sha256": "a44bfa3bc5c99c386d69be814916ec05b799aff392c421fc48fc7fa356362de8", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u051-b0053", "text": "—Oui, au moyen d'une cruche cassée. Nous en avions pour quatre ans.—À propos, ajouta Gringoire en regardant l'archidiacre d'un air à demi goguenard, vous y pensez donc toujours?", "sha256": "a931d683aebffe9eeb406d22cc55ccf87946d5861159943971e13e964c45a3ab", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [2998], "source_xml_sha256": "e0207cf7c010cadcc50c614c967cce7549fcca6a6289fce14a02dc1f52beefb3", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u051-b0054", "text": "—Et vous, vous n'y pensez plus?", "sha256": "ed61628d76dfb4a5e851ef37c4f988ffe5e1ea5367c177bd1d7645fcf51c7ccd", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [2999], "source_xml_sha256": "37e93891adcedddebdf5da196944063877a9644333403cdd7c1444683173e0b6", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u051-b0055", "text": "—Peu.—J'ai tant de choses!... Mon Dieu, que la petite chèvre était jolie!", "sha256": "6ffec1b9a3e58990069e558ef54fa90964c93e179fd5d1ccc0f1e37bad316dcb", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3000], "source_xml_sha256": "e703d04e8b40a7db4d3f88342e751f34fd571146e0f391e9d5d12a4083ec2dfb", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u051-b0056", "text": "—Cette bohémienne ne vous avait-elle pas sauvé la vie?", "sha256": "052eced7a0b043d6951204f195c66b3025ae0d0cb08c757c303e969359e7dd98", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3001], "source_xml_sha256": "06074715cd5a2144fc0d6e1e8fab8e5d459acb764b2e72cd66e79ad2981667b9", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u051-b0057", "text": "—C'est pardieu vrai.", "sha256": "0839fd4add664d8473e8182cd114dff88efbd218e8ffcdeeed38a6e5ece692fc", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3002], "source_xml_sha256": "cff8f21196a2d8a363fd248155333e18a7ef68a05b0896c7cdfbfcc8fb9cc5f5", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u051-b0058", "text": "—Eh bien! qu'est-elle devenue? qu'en avez-vous fait?", "sha256": "89e26d2009b8324937de3e434511b7d019221de58362fb49071e3f6c69dd5f99", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3003], "source_xml_sha256": "838a13f49af27275cc9d871fea78431040454be1f02d16ee6cd06743ae4c3b65", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u051-b0059", "text": "—Je ne vous dirai pas. Je crois qu'ils l'ont pendue.", "sha256": "0fce9e759538a7e5a050e1477525344a9fb671ef1a805f86b7d922d62f1b549a", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3004], "source_xml_sha256": "fc48bf23f5a305058a1e77983daf77f2de0673efa4f147fa52c07e9cdd12c29b", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u051-b0060", "text": "—Vous croyez?", "sha256": "04b56c8ddf63ad44ad73a513d8e060b5e109a2400c0f467e1f9b34ffb581aace", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3005], "source_xml_sha256": "8a09790e71fefaefdbb834c4da0866800775e8d9f505d0325db11087b145b52a", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u051-b0061", "text": "—Je ne suis pas sûr. Quand j'ai vu qu'ils voulaient pendre les gens, je me suis retiré du jeu.", "sha256": "469a83b71951a6da7f6902ec4a0aa7a22b4ee9a354fd5bcf1245ae4118079f87", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3006], "source_xml_sha256": "4d34b747764069e2d014584034ec559e11702462147f1209ced0557b13e07422", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u051-b0062", "text": "—C'est là tout ce que vous en savez?", "sha256": "da77b84445a6da04a6eda65ab7aea19a6308c7bb98e137423f799f8aff63569d", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3007], "source_xml_sha256": "59367a11fadf1de743b300f3bf26928e1fc67d7791ad13f688740f47d4e56af1", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr86-u051-b0063", "text": "—Attendez donc. On m'a dit qu'elle s'était réfugiée dans Notre-Dame, et qu'elle y était en sûreté, et j'en suis ravi, et je n'ai pu découvrir si la chèvre s'était sauvée avec elle, et c'est tout ce que j'en sais.", "sha256": "3225715e76a581d7d3ba2b328bfb85abadcecd5c69a2782fde3051ea23e02419", "role": "paragraph", "tag": "p", "source_physical_indices": [3008], "source_xml_sha256": "e6a9540b3afd364ad3b7732e27cf96501f8f4aba8d9910c115d07f8a555bb5ca", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}]}
